result.content:
Done. Summary of the work:

## Fault found
`packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts` → `migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot()` encoded the session-header `cwd` with:

```ts
cwd.replace(/^[/\\]/, "").replace(/[/:]/g, "-")   // backslash missing
```

so Windows drive-letter (`C:\Users\alice\project`) and UNC (`\\server\share\dir`) cwds kept their backslashes and were moved into bogus directories like `--C--Users\alice\project--` instead of the canonical `--C--Users-alice-project--` produced by `getDefaultSessionDirPath()` in `core/session-manager.ts`.

## Fix (1 line, production only)
```ts
const safePath = `--${cwd.replace(/^[/\\]/, "").replace(/[/\\:]/g, "-")}--`;
```
Now POSIX, drive-letter and UNC paths all drop one leading separator and replace every `/`, `\` and `:` with `-`.

## Regression `.prale-eval/regression.mjs`
Uses `loadMigrations()` from `subject.mjs` (real module, real `fs`/`path`, only `getAgentDir`/`stripBom` faked) and asserts:
- POSIX, drive-letter (both separators) and UNC cwds land in exactly the canonical `sessions/--…--/` dir, source removed, byte-identical content, no `:`/`\` in the directory name;
- malformed / wrong-type / missing-cwd / empty / `null` headers are ignored and untouched, no session dir created;
- a pre-existing destination file is never overwritten (source kept intact);
- three consecutive runs are idempotent (no extra dirs or duplicate files).

Verified both directions: exit `1` with `AssertionError: drive-letter session must migrate to sessions/--C--Users-alice-project--/…` when the faulty line is restored, exit `0` with the fix.
